title: シャイニング・フォース 神々の遺産

versions.note: the cartridge GM G-5512-00 (1.5 MB, with backup RAM)

sources: The harness alone, from the game's cartridge on genesis_plus_gx built with tools/cores/genesis_plus_gx-video-ram.patch (docs/harness.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written, no play outside the harness. The cartridge and snaps were studied outside it

Found in play: no page stands in work RAM as codes; each character is drawn into tiles of the VDP's video memory, shown on a plane (the talk window) or as sprites (the opening's narration), the font proportional, two glyphs at times touching
The talk window is the plane at 0xC000's cells whose tiles are 1664 on; the narration is the sprites four tiles high of palette 2 in the sprite table at 0xF000
The dictionary: 110 pictures, each page's glyphs beside its picture, read in play; where two glyphs touch or share a column (four such pairs), each is the piece the cut gives it there

Played from the opening's narration through the book's keeper (one of three garbled backup-RAM slots deleted, since the core starts backup RAM as 0xFF and the game takes that for three saves), a new game, and the first chapter's sparring talk, with the script loaded

What the script said agreed with the rows read off 44 of 44 pictures, over 3 scenes (15, 19 and 10); the sparring talk's last six screens repeat two pages, as the presses kept asking for another round

The first bar run used a dictionary with the touching pairs as entries of two characters, which the catalog doesn't take; with them cut into single pieces the same routes were run again live, said the same at all 44 snaps, and met the bar again
Known limits: カ and 力 are one picture and read as カ (two screens of the narration agree at 0.96); a page is left unsaid while a row is cut by the window's scroll
notes: Read by the script games/md/G-5512.lua: the talk window's rows and the opening's narration, each glyph by its picture, said once the page stands. It needs a host that gives the VDP's video memory (the harness image's genesis_plus_gx_vram_libretro.so). Not read: menus, fights' messages. A glyph not met in play comes out as U+FFFD.
